title: Morea revolt of 1453–1454
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Morea revolt of 1453–1454", at revision 1370628673, opens: "The Morea revolt of 1453–1454 was a rebellion carried out against the rule of the brothers Thomas and Demetrios Palaiologos, rulers of the Byzantine Despotate of the Morea in the Peloponnese peninsula." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q795109, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "failed peasant rebellion carried out against the rule of the brothers Thomas and Demetrios Palaiologos". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
